sections.h2: What Can We Customise in ERPNext?
sections.intro: ERPNext customization means changing forms, documents, workflows, reports or modules so the system matches how your team already works. Most changes take 1–3 weeks, and a new custom module takes 4–8 weeks. Teknoppy builds every change as a separate app, so ERPNext upgrades do not overwrite your work. Our ERPNext customization services cover six areas:
rows: New fields, layouts, mandatory rules and defaults
Invoices, quotations and delivery notes with your branding
Multi-level approvals for purchases, discounts and payments
Forms and processes ERPNext does not include
sections.note: As an ERPNext customization company Kochi firms can visit in person, we start each request with a short workshop to understand the problem before writing a single line of code.

sections.h2: Custom Fields, Forms and Print Formats

paragraphs.text: Small changes often save the most time. ERPNext field customization adds the details your team needs, such as vehicle numbers on delivery notes or project codes on purchase invoices. ERPNext form customization reorders sections, hides fields a role does not need and sets sensible defaults.

ERPNext invoice format customization gives you branded invoices, quotations and delivery notes, with your logo, bank details, terms and tax summary in the right place. For GCC clients, we design bilingual Arabic and English layouts.

sections.intro: ERPNext workflow customization puts the right checks in front of the right people. Typical examples include:

items.text: Purchase orders above a set value that need manager approval
Discounts above a set limit that need sales head sign-off
Payments that need two approvals before release
Leave and expense claims routed to the correct manager

outro.text: Each workflow sends email and system notifications, so approvers act quickly and nothing waits unseen.

Every ERPNext customization company, Kochi or elsewhere, should test workflows with real users before go-live. We run each workflow with your team on sample documents first, so approvals never block daily work.

paragraphs.text: ERPNext includes many standard reports, but owners usually want answers in their own format. Our ERPNext report customization builds the views your managers check every week, such as margin by customer, overdue receivables by salesperson and stock ageing by warehouse.

We also build dashboard cards and charts so key numbers appear on the home screen. Each report is tested against your accounts, so the figures match your books. Reports can be scheduled to arrive by email every Monday morning, so managers see the numbers without logging in.

rows: Credit-limit alerts, salesperson commission reports and delivery route fields
Batch-wise costing reports, quality check forms and job-work tracking
Progress bill formats, retention fields and site-wise cost reports
Contract renewals, technician schedules and service-level tracking

sections.h2: When Do You Need a Custom Module?

paragraphs.text: Sometimes a process has no place in standard ERPNext, such as equipment rental, service contracts or a unique quality check. That is when ERPNext custom module development makes sense.

paragraphs.html: As part of ERPNext module customization, we first check whether configuration or a small change can solve the need. If not, we build a new module with its own forms, rules and reports. This ERPNext extension development runs alongside ERPNext and shares the same data, users and permissions. For larger standalone apps, our Frappe development team takes over. Recent examples include rental agreement tracking, warranty claims and lab sample registers.

sections.h2: How Do We Keep Upgrades Safe?
sections.intro: Changes made directly in ERPNext's core code are lost or broken at the next version upgrade. We never edit the core. Instead, our ERPNext customization team follows four rules:

items.html: 1. Separate custom app. Every change lives in its own app, version-controlled in Git.
2. Documented changes. You receive a list of every field, script and report we add.
3. Tested upgrades. We test your custom app on a copy of the new version before upgrading your live system.
4. You own the code. The custom app and its documentation belong to you.

outro.text: This is why an ERPNext customization company Kochi clients choose should explain its upgrade method before quoting. Ours is written into every proposal.

items.a: Not when it is built correctly. We place every change in a separate custom app and never edit core code. Before each upgrade, we test your custom app on a copy of the new version, so your live system keeps working.

items.q: Can you change our invoice format?
items.a: Yes. We design invoices, quotations and delivery notes with your logo, bank details, terms and tax summary. GCC clients can have bilingual Arabic and English layouts. Most print formats are ready in two to five days.

items.q: Can you add approvals to purchases and payments?
items.a: Yes. We set up multi-level approvals based on value, department or document type. Approvers get notified, and documents cannot move forward until the right person signs off.

items.q: How long does a customization take?
items.a: Small changes such as fields or a print format take two to five days. Workflows and reports take one to two weeks, and a new module takes four to eight weeks. Any ERPNext customization company Kochi businesses work with should give these dates in writing.

items.q: Do you fix work done by another partner?
items.a: Yes. We review existing changes, document them and move any core edits into a proper custom app. This makes your system safe to upgrade again.

items.q: What does a customization project cost?
items.a: Cost depends on the number of changes and their complexity. A print format or a few fields costs far less than a new module. We send a fixed quote after a short requirement call, so you know the price before work starts.

items.q: Is configuration enough, or do we need custom ERPNext development?
items.a: Many needs are solved through settings alone. We always check configuration first and only recommend ERPNext feature development when settings cannot meet the need. This keeps your system simpler and cheaper to maintain.

items.q: Do you train our team on the changes?
items.a: Yes. Every release includes a short walkthrough for the people affected, plus written notes on each new field, workflow or report. Your team learns the change before it goes live, not after.
